entries.en: The Vath strongarm is in a frightful panic.
entries.fr: Le transporteur des Vathes semble paniqué.
entries.ja: ヴァスの塚のニモツハコビは、慌てているようだ。

entries.en: The Vath strongarm was ambushed by Gnath and forced to abandon his wain. Though the cargo held within is of great value, he fears his attackers still lurk thereabouts, and he asks that you recover it in his stead. Search near the river west of Loth ast Gnath for the abandoned goods.
entries.fr: Le transporteur des Vathes vous a demandé de récupérer à tout prix  qu'il a perdue en abandonnant sa charrette. Cherchez  au Déclin d'Avalonia.
entries.ja: ニモツハコビに、を回収してくるよう頼まれた。高地ドラヴァニアのアヴァロニア・フォールンで、「」を調べ「」を入手しよう。

entries.en: As expected, the Gnath were lying in ambush and waiting for someone to try to recover the Vath strongarm's property. You promptly dispatch the assailants and recover the cargo. Take it back to Loth ast Vath.
entries.fr: Vous avez trouvé la charrette et récupéré le précieux chargement.
entries.ja: を入手した。ヴァスの塚で「ニモツハコビ」に「」を渡そう。

entries.en: The Vath strongarm's cargo included a special gift for a lady Vath he has had his eye on. He is elated that you have recovered it for him, and grateful that you have avenged the Gnath's attack on him.
entries.fr: Vous avez rapporté  au transporteur. Il semblait très inquiet de ce qui serait arrivé à sa réputation s'il avait définitivement perdu ce chargement.
entries.ja: ニモツハコビにを渡した。誰よりも早く荷車を牽き、誰よりも早く荷物を運ぶことが自慢なニモツハコビにとって、荷物を奪われたと知られることは、死活問題だったようだ。

entries.en: Deliver the cargo to the Vath strongarm.
entries.ja: ニモツハコビにを渡す
entries.jaMacro: ニモツハコビに<sheet(EventItem,2001621,0)>を渡す

entries.en: We were attacked by Gnath from the Onemind! We fled in a hurry. We left behind our wain. The wain is full of goods. We must recover those goods. <click> <click> The goods are very precious. Very, very precious.
entries.macro: We were attacked by Gnath from the Onemind! We fled in a hurry. We left behind our wain. The wain is full of goods. We must recover those goods. \<click> \<click> The goods are very precious. Very, very precious.
entries.fr: Kssss... Un Fidèle m'a attaqué ! Je me suis enfui et j'ai laissé ma charrette derrière moi... Il faut que je la récupère, ksss...
entries.ja:
シシシシシ……「繋がりし者たち」に襲われた！
慌てて逃げ出したもんだから、荷車を置いてきてしまった……。
なんとかして、物資を回収しなきゃ……。

entries.en: But the Gnath may still be waiting! <click> <click> Generous hunter, you are strong. Could you recover our goods for us? We were attacked at the riverside, west of Loth ast Gnath. Our wain should still be there. Please recover our precious goods for us.

entries.fr: Elle se trouve à l'ouest de Loth ast Gnath, près de la rivière, ksss... Pouvez-vous récupérer la cargaison qui s'y trouve ?
entries.ja:
狩人の腕を見込んで頼みがあるんだ……シシシシシ。
「グナースの塚」の西の川辺に荷車がある。
そこから「」を回収してくれないか……。

entries.en: Ah, yes. This is it─delicious algae! We collected it as a gift. A gift for a special Vath. We are fond of her. Very fond of her.
entries.fr: Ksss... C'est bien ça, merci ! Je suis le transporteur des Vathes... Ma fierté est de transporter plus vite et plus efficacement que quiconque, ksss...
entries.ja:
シシシシシ……これで間違いない、ありがとう。
「ニモツハコビ」である僕の自慢は、誰よりも早く荷車を牽き、
誰よりも早く荷物を運ぶことなんだ。

entries.en: So the Gnath were indeed lying in wait? Treacherous Gnath... <click> <click> Thank you for slaying them. You have given us not just our algae. You have also given us our revenge.
entries.macro: So the Gnath were indeed lying in wait? Treacherous Gnath... \<click> \<click> Thank you for slaying them. You have given us not just our algae. You have also given us our revenge.
entries.fr: Si les autres savaient que j'ai perdu un chargement, je devrais changer mon nom en Transperdeur des Vathes ! Je suis content que nous ne partagions pas la même conscience, eux et moi, ksss...
entries.ja:
それなのに荷物を奪われたと皆に知られたら、
「ニモツハコビ」どころか「ニモツナクシ」になってしまう！
皆と意識が繋がっていなくて本当に良かったよ……シシシシシ。
